entries.title: DORA applies from 17 January 2025
entries.scope_note: The Regulation as a whole applies from this date.
entries.note: verified: Art. 64 read on EUR-Lex, CELEX 32022R2554; it applies from 17 January 2025.

entries.title: Major incident: initial notification
entries.scope_note: First report of a major ICT-related incident to the competent authority.
entries.source: Commission Delegated Reg. (EU) 2025/301 (CELEX 32025R0301), Art. 5(1)(a); Reg. (EU) 2022/2554, Art. 19(4)(a)
entries.note: verified: time limit read on EUR-Lex, CELEX 32025R0301.
entries.duration: As early as possible, within four hours from classification of the incident as major and no later than 24 hours from awareness of the incident

entries.title: Major incident: intermediate report
entries.scope_note: Status update on a major ICT-related incident after the initial notification.
entries.source: Commission Delegated Reg. (EU) 2025/301 (CELEX 32025R0301), Art. 5(1)(b); Reg. (EU) 2022/2554, Art. 19(4)(b)
entries.note: verified: time limit read on EUR-Lex, CELEX 32025R0301.
entries.duration: At the latest within 72 hours from submission of the initial notification; an updated report follows without undue delay and when regular activities are recovered

entries.title: Major incident: final report
entries.scope_note: Closing report on a major ICT-related incident, including root cause.
entries.source: Commission Delegated Reg. (EU) 2025/301 (CELEX 32025R0301), Art. 5(1)(c); Reg. (EU) 2022/2554, Art. 19(4)(c)
entries.note: verified: time limit read on EUR-Lex, CELEX 32025R0301.
entries.duration: No later than one month after the intermediate report, or after the latest updated intermediate report
